description: This file defines a class system for Leaflet, including class extension, mixins, options merging, and constructor hooks, with utility functions and inheritance mechanisms.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: A base class providing inheritance, mixins, options, and hooks for Leaflet components.

methods.name: Class.extend
methods.description: Creates a new class inheriting from the current class, with additional properties and static members.

methods.name: Class.include
methods.description: Includes a mixin into the class prototype.

methods.name: Class.mergeOptions
methods.description: Merges options into the class defaults.

methods.name: Class.addInitHook
methods.description: Adds a constructor hook to be called during initialization.
